notizie.titolo: EU sanctions against ISIL/Da’esh and Al-Qaeda: Council renews regime until 2027
notizie.descrizione: The Council extended restrictive measures against individuals and groups associated with ISIL/Da'esh and Al-Qaeda for a further year, until 31 October 2027.

notizie.titolo: Forward look: 26 October - 8 November 2026
notizie.descrizione: Overview of the main subjects to be discussed at meetings of the Council of the EU over the next two weeks and upcoming media events.

notizie.titolo: Weekly schedule of President António Costa
notizie.descrizione: Weekly schedule of President António Costa, 26 October-1 November 2026.

notizie.titolo: Media advisory - Agriculture and Fisheries Council of 26-27 October 2026
notizie.descrizione: Main agenda items, approximate timing, public sessions and press opportunities.

notizie.titolo: Press briefing - EU-Canada summit of 29-30 October 2026
notizie.descrizione: The press briefing will take place on Tuesday 27 October 2026 at 10:30.

notizie.titolo: Speech by President António Costa to the Hungarian National Assembly on the 70th anniversary of the Hungarian revolution of 1956
notizie.descrizione: On 23 October 2026, European Council President António Costa travelled to Budapest and delivered a speech to the Hungarian National Assembly on the 70th anniversary of the Hungarian revolution of 1956.

notizie.titolo: EU Inc: Council adopts position on a new EU corporate law for innovative companies
notizie.descrizione: Council adopts its negotiating position on the regulation to create a 28th regime corporate legal framework, EU inc.

notizie.titolo: UPDATED Media advisory - Accreditation for the Special European Council, 26-27 November 2026 and the EU-Western Balkans summit, 25 November 2026
notizie.descrizione: The Special European Council will take place on 26 and 27 November 2026 in the Europa building in Brussels. It will be preceded by the EU-Western Balkans summit on 25 November 2026.

notizie.titolo: EU-Western Balkans summit to take place in Brussels on 25 November
notizie.descrizione: EU and Western Balkans leaders will meet in Brussels on 25 November. The Summit will highlight the strategic importance of the relations between the EU and the Western Balkans. The President of the European Council will represent the EU at the summit together with the President of the European Commission.

notizie.titolo: Joint press release following General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Viet Nam and President of the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam Tô Lâm’s visit to the European Council and the European Commission
notizie.descrizione: On 22 October 2026, European Council President António Costa and European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen held talks with President of Viet Nam Tô Lâm in Brussels on bilateral cooperation, regional security and global challenges.

notizie.titolo: Presentation of letters of credence to the President of the European Council António Costa and the President of the European Commission Ursula von der Leyen
notizie.descrizione: President Costa and President von der Leyen received letters of credence from nineteen new Ambassadors to the European Union.

notizie.titolo: Savings and investments union: Council and Parliament strike deal to revitalise the EU’s securitisation market
notizie.descrizione: The Council and the Parliament agreed new rules to revitalise the EU’s securitisation market - an integral part of the savings and investments union (SIU) and the ‘One Europe, One Market’ roadmap to boost economic growth.

notizie.titolo: Libya/Türkiye: Statement by the High Representative on behalf of the EU on the ratification of the Libya-Türkiye MoU by Libya’s House of Representatives
notizie.descrizione: Statement by the High Representative on behalf of the EU on the ratification of the Libya-Türkiye MoU by Libya’s House of Representatives.

notizie.titolo: Simplification: Council agrees negotiating stance to cut red tape for small packaging producers
notizie.descrizione: Council agrees negotiating position on proposal for a regulation suspending extended producer responsibility.

notizie.titolo: Digital rulebook: Council agrees position to simplify data protection, privacy and cyber reporting rules
notizie.descrizione: Simplification: Council agrees position to streamline EU’s data, privacy and cyber reporting rules.

notizie.titolo: ETS market stability reserve: Council and Parliament reach provisional agreement on targeted amendment
notizie.descrizione: The Council and the European Parliament reached a provisional agreement on amending the rules on the invalidation of allowances in the market stability reserve, in order to increase long-term market liquidity and predictability within its emission trading system.

notizie.titolo: Press briefing - Agriculture and Fisheries Council of 26-27 October 2026
notizie.descrizione: Press briefing ahead of the upcoming Agriculture and Fisheries Council will take place on 23 October 2026 at 13:00.

notizie.titolo: Report by President António Costa to the European Parliament plenary session
notizie.descrizione: European Council President António Costa debriefed the European Parliament plenary in Strasbourg on the discussions held during the European Council meeting of 15 and 16 October 2026.

notizie.titolo: Joint statement by the President of the European Council António Costa and the President of the European Commission Ursula von der Leyen
notizie.descrizione: Joint statement by the President of the European Council António Costa and the President of the European Commission Ursula von der Leyen.

notizie.titolo: Il Consiglio e il Parlamento raggiungono un accordo su misure aggiornate a sostegno dell'agricoltura biologica nell'UE
notizie.descrizione: Il Consiglio e il Parlamento europeo hanno raggiunto un accordo provvisorio su norme più semplici e più chiare in materia di produzione, etichettatura, certificazione e commercio di prodotti biologici.
